study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Young et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative Modeling of Thalamic Nuclear Volumes and Characterization of Lateralized Volume Alterations in Alzheimer's Disease Versus Schizophrenia

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Seven cohorts were used: HCP DEV (Lifespan Human Connectome Project in Development = HCP-D), HCP EP (Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis = HCP-EP), HCP YA (Human Connectome Project Young Adult Study = HCP-YA), UCLA (UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study = CNP, OpenNeuro ds000030), SCZ AH (Brain correlates of speech perception in schizophrenia patients with and without auditory hallucinations, OpenNeuro ds004302 = SINGLE-SITE), HCP AGE (Lifespan Human Connectome Project in Aging = HCP-A), and ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Unprocessed T1-weighted images and clinical measures were accessed from 7 cohorts (HCP DEV, HCP EP, HCP YA, UCLA, SCZ AH, HCP AGE, and ADNI) described in Supplemental Methods."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Young2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Imaging Datasets, L35

answer.CNP: normative model training and testing (controls); clinical application (UCLA SCZ cases)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: All healthy control subjects from all 7 cohorts (n=2374) were used to build the normative model. 5-fold cross-validation was used for model selection, then the top-performing model (GAMLSS multivariate) was trained on all control samples. Case subjects from HCP EP, UCLA (CNP), SCZ AH, and ADNI cohorts were used for clinical application (z-score deviation analysis).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The model with the best overall performance based on average mean absolute error (MAE) was selected and trained on all control samples for each region." ... "z scores were calculated for cases and controls from the residuals of fitted values and the standard deviation of residuals in the control samples."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Young2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling, L63-L68; 1-s2.0-S2451902224002416-mmc1.pdf.md: Supplemental Methods / Normative Modeling, L9-L11

model-1.model-name: GAMLSS multivariate model of thalamic nuclear volumes

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative model (GAMLSS multivariate) was selected as the top-performing model after 5-fold cross-validation comparison of 6 models. The final model was trained on all 2374 control participants from 7 cohorts (HCP DEV: 628, HCP EP: 56, HCP YA: 726, UCLA: 117, SCZ AH: 22, HCP AGE: 701, ADNI: 124). The cross-validation was used only for model comparison, not for the final model training. Therefore overall-phase and train-phase are identical.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "A total of 2954 of 2978 participants ages 5.6 to 100 years passed initial quality control procedures ... Of these 2954 participants, 2374 (1279 female, 1095 male) belonged to their respective control groups" ... "The model with the best overall performance based on average mean absolute error (MAE) was selected and trained on all control samples for each region."
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Young2024.pdf.md: Results, L94; Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling, L63

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The overall and train phases are identical because the final model was trained on all controls. Per-cohort control age statistics from Table 2: HCP DEV (n=628, mean=14.4, SD=4.1, range 5.6-21.9), HCP EP (n=56, mean=24.9, SD=4.1, range 16.8-35.7), HCP YA (n=726, mean=28.7, SD=3.7, range 22.0-37.0), UCLA (n=117, mean=31.0, SD=8.5, range 21.0-50.0), SCZ AH (n=22, mean=41.0, SD=14.5, range 20.0-64.0), HCP AGE (n=701, mean=60.4, SD=15.8, range 36.0-100.0), ADNI (n=124, mean=73.4, SD=6.2, range 56.2-85.6). Weighted mean = sum(n_i * mean_i) / N = 87244.8 / 2374 = 36.75. Pooled SD = sqrt(sum(n_i * sd_i^2) / N) = sqrt(214279.93 / 2374) = 9.50. Min = 5.6 (HCP DEV), Max = 100.0 (HCP AGE). The abstract states 'ages 5 to 100 years' and Table 2 confirms the range.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "2374 (1279 female, 1095 male) belonged to their respective control groups" ... "participants ages 5.6 to 100 years passed initial quality control procedures"

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The overall and train phases are identical because the final model was trained on all 2374 controls. Female: 1279/2374 = 53.9%. Male: 1095/2374 = 46.1%. Per-cohort breakdown from Table 2: HCP DEV (337F/291M), HCP EP controls (19F/37M), HCP YA (398F/328M), UCLA controls (55F/62M), SCZ AH controls (7F/15M), HCP AGE (395F/306M), ADNI controls (68F/56M). Sum: Female = 337+19+398+55+7+395+68 = 1279; Male = 291+37+328+62+15+306+56 = 1095.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "Of these 2954 participants, 2374 (1279 female, 1095 male) belonged to their respective control groups"
